Update README's Executive Brain roadmap so it no longer says E3 planned / E4-E5 future when current evidence says otherwise. Preserve nuance between implemented/verified, Stage2 enabled, and production deployed.
Reconcile state/current_company_state.md so its header/latest-evidence metadata reflects the newest incorporated evidence while preserving the historical evidence chronology below it.

Represent production blockers explicitly and separately from implementation completion: seven remaining provider credentials absent, Stage2 disabled, live-provider failover gap, deployment/cutover decision, off-site backup, battery gating, reboot persistence, laptop trust audit, and other owner-gated optional integrations as currently evidenced.

Do not label Gmail OAuth, research provider, LinkedIn live account access, recruiter live feed or regional work-authorisation decisions as core production blockers unless the documented product scope actually requires them; distinguish optional/feature-gated coverage from release blockers.
Add CI/local verification to compare generated artifacts/status against source evidence without accessing secrets.
Commit/push generated artifacts and generator sources with exact generation command and evidence timestamp.
stop_conditions: Do not overwrite historical acceptance evidence.
Do not turn owner-gated UNKNOWNs into PASS.
Do not claim production-ready while deployment blockers remain.
Do not hand-edit the generated tracker as the primary maintenance path once the generator exists.
notes: Independent audit found the PDF visually sound but statically drifting, README roadmap stale, and current_company_state header older than later work. Goal is one project-level view that can be regenerated and verified rather than manually synchronized.

result.summary: Introduced one canonical machine-readable project-status source (status/canonical-status.json) and made the executive tracker and the drift-prone status surfaces generated + verified from it, rather than hand-synchronised. New: scripts/status_sources.py (evidence reader/validator), scripts/status_render.py (deterministic renderer), scripts/status_verify.py (verification command), scripts/tests/test_status_consistency.py (23 tests, registered as suite 22 in scripts/evidence_runner.py). Generated outputs: status/executive-tracker.md (full tracker) plus generated status blocks injected between markers into README.md (Executive Brain roadmap), state/current_company_state.md (status header) and state/full_build_tracker.md (status header) — historical chronology and narrative below each block preserved verbatim. README no longer says E3 planned / E4-E5 future; implemented+verified, Stage 2 enabled and production deployed are kept as three distinct states (E1/E2 ACTIVE and verified; E3 implemented+verified with Stage 2 NOT ENABLED; E4/E5 implemented and drill-verified against stubbed provider failures only). Verification fails when a generated surface is stale or when a figure disagrees with the evidence artifact it names (regression counts, roster accounting, credential presence, deployment preflight, E4/E5 drill results, persistence) and warns on evidence newer than the status as_of; drift was proven detectable by injecting a tampered figure (verify exited 1) and regenerating (exited 0). Ten production blockers are represented separately from implementation completion (provider credentials absent, Stage 2 disabled, live-provider failover gap, deployment/cutover decision, off-site backup absent, battery gating, reboot persistence unverified, laptop trust audit, unattended interactive-token constraint, log rotation/retention), while Gmail read-only OAuth, research provider, live LinkedIn account access, recruiter live feed and regional work-authorisation are recorded as optional/feature-gated, not release blockers. Later Career discovery work is included (B25 high-recall funnel, B11 recruiter-watch, B19/B20/B21 LinkedIn, B22, B26 open-web research with its bounded live pass, B27 priority watchlist), and the scheduled-orchestrator cutover is recorded truthfully as NOT COMPLETE / BLOCKED (execution_error, 3/3 attempts, no committed effect). While executing, an owner handover appeared on the remote recording that 3 of the 7 previously absent credentials (Mistral, Qwen, GLM) were configured; the presence-only probe was re-run read-only (0 network calls, 0 provider calls, no credential value read) confirming 3 of 7 configured and 4 still absent, and the canonical status was updated to that measured state without promoting 'credential present' to routable/qualified and without enabling Stage 2. Generation command: `python scripts/status_render.py`; verification: `python scripts/status_verify.py`; evidence timestamp at as_of 2026-09-24T15:36:57Z. Committed and pushed to origin/main.
